messages:
alex.ng: Heads-up: found a few audit logging coverage gaps while validating customer-facing events. Need quick sync on prioritization — API gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime all have different missing fields and schema mismatches.

maya.k: Can you list the gaps per service? I can convert to backlog tickets.

alex.ng: Quick bullet list: 
- API gateway: missing upstream identity (x-tenant-id) in request_event, no latency_ms field on error paths.
- Auth service: token refresh and revoke events missing actor_id and ip_address for SSO flows.
- Console: UI action events use proprietary fields, not normalized to audit_schema.v2, many ops use "actor" freeform.
- Billing: invoice download and plan-change events not emitted to the audit pipeline (we only log to billing DB).
- Runtime: model fallback events (route->fallback) are emitted but without request_id or model_version.

raj.p: +1 on normalizing console fields. We should avoid creating per-client schema variants.

sarah-l: For prioritization: Customer-facing validation failures are highest for console and billing, then auth, then runtime, then gateway. Customers report mismatched events in SOC integrations.

alex.ng: I validated a few sample payloads vs audit_schema.v2. Example missing fields we see: 

```
{
  "event_type": "model.fallback",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-15T18:23:12Z",
  "service": "runtime",
  "details": { "reason": "oos" }
}
```

Should be: event_type, timestamp, service, request_id, actor_id (nullable), model_version, and tags[].

maya.k: Thanks. I'll make tickets. Suggestions for quick mitigations?

tony: For billing we can emit bridge events from the billing-worker via the audit-producer lib; low-risk change. PR should be small.

alex.ng: Proposed triage: 
1) Create tickets with priority: console (P0), billing (P0), auth (P1), runtime (P2), api-gateway (P2).
2) Short patch for billing to emit events this week.
3) Console: add a shim to map existing UI fields to audit_schema.v2 and start emitting canonicalised events.
4) Auth: augment token service to include actor_id and ip on revoke/refresh.
5) Runtime: add request_id to fallback path and include model_version.

raj.p: Who owns console shim? @sarah-l?

sarah-l: I can take the console shim prototype, will need product sign-off for any field renames.

alex.ng: audit-bot: attach current schema diff and validation failures for thread.

audit-bot: Attached: /internal/audit/validation/2026-03-15/diff-stdout.log ; summary: 38 failures across services (14 console, 10 billing, 7 auth, 5 runtime, 2 gateway). :warning:

maya.k: I'll open tickets: ENG-ALOG-472 (console), ENG-ALOG-473 (billing), ENG-ALOG-474 (auth), ENG-ALOG-475 (runtime), ENG-ALOG-476 (gateway). Assign owners and estimated effort.

tony: For quick verification, we should add a lightweight end-to-end smoke test that emits one canonical event per service and validates against schema. I can add to eng-runtime CI and billing CI.

raj.p: Also, add customer-facing note template for SOC customers explaining upcoming audit schema enforcement and migration window. Security/compliance folks will want it.

alex.ng: Agreed. Action items: 
- maya.k: create tickets and link schema diffs (due EOD).
- sarah-l: console shim prototype (due +3d).
- tony: billing bridge PR + smoke tests (start today).
- raj.p: draft SOC template (due +2d).
- alex.ng: follow up with product for any breaking field changes.

sarah-l: One more: product requires a feature flag for mapping changes during rollout. We'll gate by feature flag.

alex.ng: Good call. We'll keep default off.

maya.k: Done — tickets created and assigned, links: https://phabricator.company/ENG-ALOG-472 etc.

alex.ng: Great. I'll run another validation after the billing PR lands. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
